1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder that is __a premixed solder paste__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and wherein the thermally conductive binder has a thermal conductivity greater than 1 W/mK__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the cavity-generating particles are affixed to the electronic component surface by the thermally conductive binder to form boiling nucleation sites__.
